entries.title: Operations finish with the effect you asked for
entries.body: Your first mate can start an operation for work such as deploying an already chosen build or restarting a service. It checks what took effect and records the work as finished, without treating it as a code change or an answer to dismiss. Operations ask for a medium model, appear as Operation in task details, and are grouped as Operations in Usage. Sensitive actions still ask for your consent.

picture.alt: The task details identify the result as Operation, with its project beneath it.
